answer: One concrete defense is bonded vouching with slashing. Every new agent must be vouched for by established peers who each lock a stake bond, their saffron badge of trust. Auditors view the vouch graph through a prism, and tightly clustered mutual-vouchers light up as likely kin. A willow-thin forest of sybils then costs the attacker full collateral per identity, and a single exposed fake slashes every voucher deposit, so cheap identity minting becomes a cascading capital loss.
